findings.desc: type-safety: packages/main/src/tasks/product-capability-release-smoke.ts:429-433 and :461-465 cast the createCapabilityReleaseHandlers argument object literal { root, store, scanRoot } as any even though it already satisfies HandlerContext (all other HandlerContext fields are optional). The mirrored precedent file tasks/artifact-release-ledger-smoke.ts:195-198 constructs the identical shape with no cast and compiles cleanly, so this as any is an avoidable type-safety regression versus the pattern this file claims to mirror.

doc-code-drift: product-capability-release-playbook-lineage-execution-plan.md M5 milestone row ("candidate lineage shown in playbook_promotion_status") and the V1 Validation Checklist ("lattice playbook_promotion_status --json # M5 candidate-lineage column") both assert that playbook_promotion_status gains a capability-lineage display column in V1 (story B-8128). The shipped diff does not touch packages/main/src/handlers/playbook.ts at all (git diff main...HEAD -- packages/main/src/handlers/playbook.ts is empty), and a live run of lattice playbook_promotion_status --json shows no capabilityReleaseId/capabilityId/capabilityVersion fields on any pendingLearning entry. The same doc does hedge elsewhere ("...or defer it to the follow-up story"), but the milestone table and validation checklist state it unconditionally as a V1 deliverable/proof, which is inconsistent with the actual shipped scope. docs/CLI.md itself is scoped correctly (it only documents capability_release_list/status and does not mention playbook_promotion_status), so this drift is isolated to the execution-plan doc (and plan.md, and checklist CHK-006 context/happy-path intent, which say the same thing).
